name: baton
description: Deterministic ticket/DAG/subagent control plane over OpenSpec changes: a local Python CLI computes the task frontier and returns session actions; the main session dispatches each task packet to a subagent in an isolated git worktree, and only a sealed receipt with green verification counts as done. Bundles the baton skill, the CLI and a standalone resource-queue CLI.

description_i18n.en: Deterministic ticket/DAG/subagent control plane over OpenSpec changes: a local Python CLI computes the task frontier and returns session actions; the main session dispatches each task packet to a subagent in an isolated git worktree, and only a sealed receipt with green verification counts as done. Bundles the baton skill, the CLI and a standalone resource-queue CLI.
description_i18n.zh-CN: OpenSpec 变更的确定性 ticket/DAG/子代理控制面：本地 Python CLI 计算任务前沿并返回会话动作；主会话把任务包派发到隔离 git worktree 中的子代理，只有验证全绿的密封回执才算完成。内置 baton 技能、控制面 CLI 与可独立使用的资源队列 CLI。
